```lean
theorem lg_target (p : NNReal) (h : p ≤ 1) : PMF.bernoulli p h true = (p : ENNReal) := by
  -- The Bernoulli PMF at true is simply p, so we directly show this equality
  rw [PMF.bernoulli_def]
  simp only [ENNReal.ofNat, NNReal.cast_coe, NNReal.cast_id, NNReal.cast_one, NNReal.cast_zero, NNReal.cast_eq_coe]
  exact rfl
```
